summary: Parse three banks' messy statement exports into one normalized format
hard_because: Real-world CSV mess documented in FORMATS.md: BOM, CRLF, ';' and ',' delimiters, decimal comma, thousands separators (including no-break space), trailing-minus and parenthesized negatives, three date formats, quoted descriptions with newlines, footer lines. Hidden files combine these.
instruction: Write import_statement.py with a function `parse_statement(path)` that reads a bank statement export from any of our three banks and returns a list of transactions as dicts `{"bank": str, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "amount_cents": int, "description": str}` in file order. FORMATS.md documents the three formats; samples/ has one real export from each bank (with personal data removed). Raise ValueError for a file that is none of the three formats. Standard library only.
